The '''Black Sun Token of Heroism''' was a special award given by the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal syndicate to those of its members who performed heroic actions in the name of the organization.

==Behind the scenes==
These tokens appear in ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' as a unique currency the player can acquire for completing the recapture of the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Blackguard (Star Destroyer)|''Blackguard'']]. They can then be used to purchase various items from the village of [[Aurilia]].
